raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 0.11.2

recipe:
  name: jsf
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jsf/jsf-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 07055b363281d38ce871a9256a00587d8472802c5108721a7fe5884465104b5d

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python

outputs:
  - package:
      name: jsf
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
      python:
        entry_points:
          - jsf = jsf.cli:app
    requirements:
      host:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - setuptools
      run:
        - faker >=15.3.4
        - jsonschema >=4.17.3
        - pydantic >=2.0.0
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - rstr >=3.2.0
        - smart-open-with-http >=6.3.0
        - typing_extensions >=4.9.0
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jsf

  - package:
      name: jsf-with-cli
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jsf", exact=True) }}
        - typer >=0.7.0
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
          imports:
            - jsf
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pyjwt
            - pytest-cov
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - jsf --help
          - coverage run --source jsf --branch -m pytest -vv --pyargs jsf -vv --tb=long --color=yes
          - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=99

about:
  summary: Creates fake JSON files from a JSON schema
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - jsf/LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/ghandic/jsf

extra:
  feedstock-name: jsf
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
